objective: The decision classifiers of package 22.2 (one per point of the generated decision sets of 22.1), each judged once on its point's sealed decisions by decision_gate_v1 (dclab_core/decision_gate.py), beside the rule on the same decisions. The gate was committed and pushed before any sealed row was read; each sealed set is read once, under any gate version.

why.accuracy_lower_min 0.90: A model that answers a technical decision beside the rule should be right nine times in ten at worst; the agent benchmark's gate_v1 asks a Wilson lower bound of 0.80 on a harder task (leaks caught across whole cases).
why.precision_lower_min and recall_lower_min: The same bar as gate_v1's leaks-caught lower bound: a model that misses or invents one decision in five is not ready to stand beside the rule.
why.margin_lower_min 0.0 (strictly above): A model is promoted only if it is better than the rule on the same decisions, with the 95% lower bound of the difference above zero; matching the rule is not enough, since the rule is free and explainable.
why.class_recall_min 0.70 over classes of 30: As gate_v1's weak family: an aggregate must not hide a class the model misses.
why.turned_max 0.02: A model that fixes the rule's errors but breaks its right answers trades one kind of mistake for another; two in a hundred is the most it may break.
why.bounds by table group: A table's decisions, and a table and its hidden-name twin, are not independent; every lower bound is a bootstrap of whole table groups (2000 draws, seed 0).

gate.seen_before: The thresholds were set after the dev figures of the cards in research/llm-fine-tuning/experiments/decisions/models_v1/ were seen, and before any sealed row was read. Expected from dev, written before the run: column.is_identifier and column.group cannot pass (the rule is exact on dev, so the margin cannot be above zero); column.category_code is expected to fail (dev precision lower bound 0.711); column.time is expected to fail (dev recall 0.622); column.semantic_role is expected to pass unless the turned-wrong share is above 0.02 (not measured on dev); feature.leakage_suspect sits at the recall bar (dev recall lower bound 0.779 by Wilson) and could go either way.
gate.not_yet: Blind cases (the main product's R3 asks for them): the generated sets have benchmark labels only; decision_gate_v2 adds the blind labels of 22.4's disagreements, on a new sealed set.

rule: Verdicts say how each classifier reads planted kinds in generated tables like those it was trained on, beside the rule on the same decisions; nothing about real tables nor production readiness. A sealed set is read once.
